acceptanceCriteria: All source quality and release checks pass; the exact next version is consistent across Cargo metadata and tri-language current-baseline docs; annotated tag and public Release assets bind the merged main commit; public and N-1 adopter acceptance prove isolation and cleanup; release WI is archived, finalized, closed, and main is synchronized.
goal: Update the package identity and tri-language release documentation for the next strategy-approved patch, then complete reviewed PR, annotated-tag publication, published-artifact acceptance, and governed release closure.
intent: Publish the next patch release after completing the integrated trust diagnostics and governance documentation recovery.
outOfScope: and publishing before PR merge and release gates pass.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: reviewed source produces one v0.2.90 identity
scenarioCoverage.expected: Cargo metadata, Cargo.lock, current tri-language projections, the reviewed merge commit, annotated v0.2.90 tag, public manifest, and published binary identity agree.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run source checks before the PR, bind the tag only to synchronized merged main after hosted checks pass, then validate the public manifest and downloaded binary identity.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: reviewed PR passes the integrated release gate
scenarioCoverage.expected: Hosted route, quality, behavioral, Windows runtime, and task-completion checks pass for the exact reviewed head before merge.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Push the dedicated branch, create one PR, inspect every required hosted check, and merge only the reviewed green head.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: public release artifact passes isolated adopter installation
scenarioCoverage.expected: The downloaded v0.2.90 public archive passes version, manifest, checksum, Runtime identity, root isolation, and temporary-root cleanup checks without using the workspace binary.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the public adopter harness against the downloaded Release artifact with isolated HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, TMPDIR, and CARGO_HOME roots, then retain the receipt and manifests.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: v0.2.89 to v0.2.90 preserves the N-1 boundary
scenarioCoverage.expected: An isolated adopter upgrades from the previous public v0.2.89 archive to v0.2.90, preserves governed history, records same-schema compatibility, and cleans all temporary roots.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the public upgrade harness with immutable v0.2.89 and v0.2.90 Release artifacts and compare the retained history digest.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: governed release closure is bound to the merged source
scenarioCoverage.expected: The Work Item archive, finalization, close, exact branch/worktree cleanup, synchronized main, and post-close promotion check all bind the reviewed merged source and release evidence.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Complete finish and archive before merge, record provider finalization after merge and cleanup, close with explicit authorization, synchronize main, and run the closed-work-item promotion check.
